ai_summary: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited has allotted 400,341 new equity shares on August 14, 2026, pursuant to employees exercising stock options under its ESOP 2020, which increased the paid-up equity share capital to Rs. 4,37,73,74,580. This action results in a minor dilution for existing shareholders due to the increased share count. As a standard corporate event for ESOP exercises, this disclosure presents no apparent red flags or significant material impacts.
